tools.name: maintenance_copilot_query
tools.description: Answer an aircraft-maintenance question (AMM/MEL/CDL/TSM/defect/dispatch/ATA) with grounded RAG: returns a cited, confidence-scored answer and renders it as a maintenance-answer card in the UI. Advisory only — never a dispatch decision.
